Chapter 1477 - 15: On The Road (Grand Finale Tomorrow)

Chapter 1477: Chapter 15: On the Road (Grand Finale Tomorrow)

So naturally, he wouldn’t make a move against Lord Wanwei, but instead, deliberately spared a sliver of power to send him back to his original time and space.

At the same time.

Having already resigned himself to death, Lord Wanwei was stunned to discover that the invisible aura that swept towards him had dissipated completely.

Not only that, the space-time that had turned into a prison from which one could enter but not exit, silently tore open a gap.

A gentle force wrapped around Lord Wanwei, pulling him into the torn gap, away from this time and space.

...

The slaughter continued unabated.

The entire endless dimensional realm became Lin Yuan’s killing field.

All the Legendary Lords involved in the trillion disasters of the current time and space came under Lin Yuan’s reprisal and eradication.

They threatened him by any means necessary, but Lin Yuan naturally had no need to hold back and let them completely perish.

"What is happening?"

"Why are the Legendary Lords perishing one after another?"

The other Legendary Lords were parched in the mouth; over ninety percent of the Legendary Lords of the trillion disasters in this time and space had participated in preventing the Galaxy Lord from ascending the steps of white jade.

But there was still ten percent of the Legendary Lords of the trillion disasters who, out of caution, did not partake, thereby inadvertently avoiding a life-and-death catastrophe.

"The Galaxy, has the power of the Galaxy Lord... transcended?"

"Horrific entities from different times and spaces, starting at three trillion disasters, some even nearing the end of the transcendence path, have completely and utterly perished?"

"It’s terrifying."

"Transcendence, if this isn’t transcendence, what is?"

Numerous Legendary Lords watched the slaughter from afar, hearts filled with shock and reverence.

"This is the Galaxy..."

Purple Light Legendary Lord swallowed deeply, recalling the scene shown when Lin Yuan was forced to summon his future self within the Wanwei time and space.

In the scene, an endless staircase of white jade ascended endlessly, with only one figure continually climbing — the future Lin Yuan.

"So... I’ve long since witnessed the outcome of this disaster..." the Purple Light Legendary Lord muttered to himself.

At that time, Lin Yuan’s future self was still climbing the white jade steps, unobstructed.

This means that the disaster decreed by the Supreme Rule Dao — to prevent the Galaxy from ascending — was doomed to fail.

Yet, what the Purple Light Legendary Lord did not expect was such a cruel outcome of failure.

All involved Legendary Lords, none escaped, all perished completely.

"The Galaxy..."

The proprietor of the Time-Space Shop, the twelve-eyed anomalous beast, was also observing from afar.

He was not even a Legendary Lord and could not even clearly see the scenes of battle, but it was evident that those terrifying entities, the Legendary Lords who had joined forces to attack, seemed to be thoroughly suppressed by the Galaxy Lord.

...

The fallen Legendary Lords were too numerous, the terrifying entities from different times and spaces aside, just the Legendary Lords of the trillion disasters from the current time and space, over ten thousand fell completely.

Over ten thousand Legendary Lords of the trillion disasters?

This was the accumulation of countless ages of Legendary Lords of the trillion disasters, all fallen in Lin Yuan’s slaughter.

The Legendary Lords watching from afar, though not directly impacted, were no less afraid, the Legendary Lords of this time and space would undoubtedly have to endure an unprecedented epoch of darkness.

Witnessing the fall and death of mighty Legendary Lords one after another, the aura of slaughter permeated heaven and earth.

Once reigning supreme above all, in this disaster, the Legendary Lords were as worthless as ants.

...

Time passed by.

To thoroughly eliminate every participating Legendary Lord, Lin Yuan maintained the slaughter for several days.

Mainly because of the prolific survival tactics of the horrific entities from different times and spaces, even though the new Dao formed from the fusion of five Chaotic Origin Daos possessed absolute crushing power.

But locking down one by one the various survival tactics of these horrific entities took quite some time, especially those survival tactics involving the mind, where as long as a living being remembered the name of a horrific entity, it could use it as an anchor point to return.

To eliminate these mental anchor points, Lin Yuan spent considerable effort.

But it was merely effort, after several days, Lin Yuan finally completed the slaughter.

"Disperse now."

Lin Yuan thought, the time and space that had turned into a cage from which one could only enter but not exit, gradually opened up again.

Solidifying this segment of time and space was still quite taxing for the current Lin Yuan, now that all enemies were dealt with, there was no need to maintain it anymore.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan pondered as he glanced at the endless dimensional realm.

More precisely, he looked at the will of the Supreme Rule Dao that traversed the endless dimensional realm.

Rumbling — the will of the Supreme Rule Dao roared, but eventually retreated quickly.

The will of the Supreme Rule Dao is an entity that maintains the operation of the endless dimensional realm, devoid of a specific consciousness or will, incapable of acting against a particular being personally.

This time, as Lin Yuan ascended the white jade steps, the will of the Supreme Rule Dao, regardless of its reluctance, did not act against Lin Yuan, but rather rallied the most powerful lords from different time and spaces.

"Does the will of the Supreme Rule Dao... not wish for a transcendent existence to arise from the endless dimensional realm? This path of infinite disasters should not truly lead to transcendence..."

Lin Yuan was almost certain in his heart.

Infinite tribulations stem from the will of the Supreme Rule Dao; if the latter is unwilling for there to be transcenders, the end of this path of transcendence cannot be transcendence.

...

Whish!

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand.

The Chaos Void reappeared in its original place.

Lin Yuan took a step forward, returning to the Chaos Void.

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

The time beings like Lord Mo Xu looked at Lin Yuan who appeared not far away, their expressions were both shocked and awed.

Although Lin Yuan directly absorbed the Chaos Void into his inner universe, only now bringing it out.

But the time beings like Lord Mo Xu left avatars in the outer world, in the vast dimensional gaps.

The battle between the Galaxy Lord and the over five hundred terrifying entities from different time-spaces, as well as over ten thousand Legendary Lords of current time-space who had endured a billion tribulations, was of immense commotion.

Even a First Realm time being could sense something from the aftermath of the battlefield.

"Everything is over."

Lin Yuan nodded towards Lord Mo Xu and the other time beings.

"It’s all over?"

The time beings exchanged a glance, feeling a slight chill down their spines.

Before the Chaos Void was absorbed by Lin Yuan, they had also sensed the presence of those terrifying entities arriving; could it be that Lin Yuan had dealt with all those terrifying entities?

"Galaxy, those enemies..."

Luo Hou asked with a forced composure.

He had some guesses in his heart, and due to his connection with Lin Yuan, he had befriended some Time Lords who told him a lot of incredibly unbelievable information.

"They’re all dead."

Lin Yuan glanced at Luo Hou, casually saying: "Completely dead."

Upon hearing this.

The time beings like Lord Mo Xu felt a bit bewildered in their hearts.

Initially, they were prepared for self-extinguishment, not giving the enemies a chance to threaten Lin Yuan.

But now it seemed that all the enemies had been completely vanquished.

After a good while.

Lord Mo Xu steadied himself and couldn’t help but ask: "Galaxy, have you transcended?"

The other time beings in the Chaos Void perked up their ears upon hearing this.

They also wanted to know the answer to this question.

In fact, it wasn’t just them; the remaining Legendary Lords in the endless dimensional spaces wanted to know if the Galaxy Lord had truly transcended.

Although many speculations followed that the Galaxy Lord had transcended, these were ultimately just speculations.

"Transcended?"

Lin Yuan’s face remained calm, and he did not answer directly.

Instead, he looked at the outside of the Chaos Void, at the higher reaches of endless dimensional spaces.

It was as if he was observing himself climbing the white jade steps, having comprehended the final type of Chaotic Origin Dao, Lin Yuan underwent a complete qualitative transformation. Even after spending several days slaughtering numerous lords, it didn’t expend much of his energy; the true self on the white jade steps had long resumed climbing.

Giving another glance at Lord Mo Xu and the other time beings.

Lin Yuan smiled slightly.

And gave a reply.

"On the path."

...
